panel.confirm_note: Writes go to the NetworkManager profile. After the connection comes back up you have {seconds}s to keep the change before it is rolled back.
panel.confirm_note_off: Writes are applied immediately: confirm_seconds is 0, so there is no rollback window.
panel.ipv6_hint: IPv6 addresses take a prefix; a bare address gets /64.
panel.no_connections: NetworkManager has no editable connection profiles.
panel.no_live: The device is not reporting addresses right now.
panel.pending: {name} was changed. Keeping it in {seconds}s, otherwise the previous settings are restored.
panel.permission: NetworkManager needs authorization to modify system connections; changes will be refused.
panel.profile_hint: Addresses take a prefix; a bare address gets /24.
panel.unavailable: nmcli is not on PATH — NetworkManager is required.
